subject.title: fix(macos): reject revoked forwarded exec approvals

question: Should approval-requiring nodes without `system.run.prepare` fail closed as part of this security fix, even though existing legacy node workflows may stop working after upgrade?
rationale: Gateway cannot prove a remote executable or mutable-file identity locally, but accepting the safer fail-closed contract changes an existing compatibility path and requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept fail-closed boundary
options.body: Require prepare support for approval-requiring runs and merge after lint repair and live dual-route proof.

options.title: Preserve legacy compatibility
options.body: Pause this PR and design an authenticated remote preparation contract that proves node-side identity without Gateway-local synthesis.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed boundary
recommendation.body: Require prepare support for approval-requiring runs and merge after lint repair and live dual-route proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the canonical snapshot/store work and the recent implementation across both affected execution routes.
